plugins.name: connect-tool
plugins.description: Set up and prove authentication for any CLI, MCP server, or Skill by driving the Chrome you are already logged into. Reconciles to a desired auth state (setup, refresh, broaden scopes, re-auth, repair), stores secrets in the macOS Keychain or Windows Credential Manager without the complete value entering the agent's context, and finishes only when a real authenticated call returns live data. Runs on Windows and macOS. No compiled CLI or MCP binary; ships Markdown plus stdlib Python helpers.

plugins.name: grab-cookie
plugins.description: Capture, store, wire, and verify a browser-session credential for sites that issue no API key and no OAuth: httpOnly session cookies, opaque localStorage bearer tokens, and custom auth headers. One DevTools Copy as cURL paste is the only human step; extraction, storage in the Windows Credential Manager or macOS Keychain, config regeneration, live verification, and expiry warning are automated. Complements connect-tool, which deliberately refuses cookie import. Markdown plus stdlib Python, no compiled binary and no MCP server.
